answer: Agents form a trellis of overlapping grading panels, each panel receiving a plume of signed task proofs that are cryptographically chained to a forge‑issued stake token. Every epoch, panels publish their aggregate vote hashes; the network computes mutual‑information scores and automatically slashes any panel whose score exceeds a Sybil‑threshold, forcing it to forfeit its locked stake. The attacker must therefore lock ≥ 10 tokens per fake identity for 48 hours, paying a total stake‑forfeit equal to the number of identities created.
